name: Iowa
dueDateNotes: Iowa follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Iowa taxes your income at a flat 3.8% for 2026. Iowa's standard deduction is not reflected in this estimate, so your actual Iowa tax may be slightly lower.
uniqueFacts: Iowa finished phasing in a flat 3.8% income tax for 2026, replacing its old graduated brackets.
Starting in 2026, Iowa only requires estimated payments once you expect to owe $1,000 or more (up from the old $200 threshold).
Iowa does not tax retirement income for residents 55 and older, though that break does not apply to self-employment earnings.
